children: The following bids, mergers, acquisitions and disposals were reported by 1945 GMT on Friday:
** Grupa Azoty
CEO Marcin Celejewski told reporters on Friday that the sale of the group's idle Polyolefins unit to state-controlled refiner Orlen
would be completed this year, and did not rule out it happening in November.
** Fintech firm BILL Holdings
said on Thursday it will be acquired by private equity group TPG, in partnership with Corpay
, in an all-cash transaction valued at about $6 billion.
** Intuit
said on Thursday it has agreed to sell email marketing platform Mailchimp to Bending Spoons
for about $3.68 billion, five years after acquiring it for nearly three times more in its largest deal ever.
** German media and services group Bertelsmann agreed to buy Turkey-based Ekol Logistics for more than €500 million ($548 million), the companies said on Thursday.
** Italy's biggest utility Enel
said it had agreed to acquire a portfolio of solar plants in the US, bringing its installed renewable capacity in North America to 13.5 gigawatts (GW), including storage assets.
** Evonik's
top shareholder, the RAG foundation, said it still aims to gradually reduce its stake in the German chemicals company to 25.1%, after BASF
ended its pursuit of Evonik.
** Metro Bank
is attracting early takeover interest from Barclays
and private equity firms, including Lone Star Funds and Centerbridge Partners, after the British mid-tier lender put itself up for sale, Bloomberg News reported on Friday.
** Officials from US President Donald Trump's administration met privately this week with hedge fund investors who were betting on the outcome of Union Pacific's
proposed $72 billion acquisition of Norfolk Southern
, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
** Christian Dior
said on Friday its board had approved the terms of the planned merger of family holding company Agache into Christian Dior, as well as the company's conversion into a limited joint-stock partnership.
**  Private equity firm GTCR is exploring a potential takeover of payments processor Global Payments
, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Friday, days after reports that a consortium effort with CD&R was dropped.
